title: Sync local develop — commit nanoclip task status updates and fast-forward to origin
description:
Local develop is behind origin/develop by ~20 commits. The working tree contains uncommitted nanoclip task status updates (tasks 002-028 marked done, task 034 added, counter updated). Package file changes in the working tree are identical to origin/develop and do not need to be committed.

Steps:
1. Create branch chore/sync-develop from local develop
2. Stage and commit only the .nanoclip/ changes (counter.txt and tasks/*.json)
3. Rebase branch onto origin/develop (fast-forward local)
4. Open PR against develop
5. Code review and QA verify task states are accurate
6. Merge
